# Wall Street Numbers

> > Comprehensive financial data platform providing historical stock metrics, market capitalization, EPS, P/E ratios, and stock screeners for NASDAQ, NYSE, and S&P 500 companies.

Wall Street Numbers delivers detailed historical financial data and analysis tools for US-listed stocks, including companies like NVIDIA, Apple, Applied Materials, and major indices like the Magnificent 7, NASDAQ 100, and Dow Jones. The platform offers industry-specific screeners, technical indicators, and fundamental metrics spanning decades of market history.

## Key Topics

- S&P 500
- NASDAQ
- NYSE
- NASDAQ 100
- Market Capitalization
- Stock Screeners
- Historical Stock Data
- EPS (Earnings Per Share)
- P/E Ratio
- Stock Price History
- Technology Sector
- Magnificent 7
- Financial Metrics
- Stock Fundamentals
- Technical Analysis

## Stock Screeners & Lists

- [All American Stocks Listed On NASDAQ & NYSE](https://wallstreetnumbers.com/screeners/united-states-stocks): Complete list of US stocks on NASDAQ and NYSE exchanges
- [Stocks Above 50 Day Moving Average](https://wallstreetnumbers.com/screeners/stocks-above-sma50): Stock screener for companies trading above 50-day moving average
- [List Of Companies With Growing Shares Outstanding](https://wallstreetnumbers.com/screeners/shares-outstanding-increase): Stock screener for companies with increasing shares outstanding
- [List Of High Altman Z Score Stocks](https://wallstreetnumbers.com/screeners/high-altman-z-score): Stock screener for companies with high Altman Z-Score financial health

- [Leisure Industry Companies Listed On NASDAQ & NYSE](https://wallstreetnumbers.com/screeners/leisure-industry): Leisure industry stock screener with fitness and entertainment companies
- [Construction & Engineering Companies Listed On NASDAQ & NYSE](https://wallstreetnumbers.com/screeners/construction-engineering-companies): Construction & engineering sector screener with industrials stocks
